answer_4.quote: We ask 5 annotators to classify each pair into one of the following categories: aligned, partially-aligned, or not-aligned. Annotators are required to spend at least 25 seconds on each question. The annotation instructions and interface can be found in Appendix D. We embed one hidden test question in every five questions, and the workers need to maintain an accuracy over 85% on the test questions to continue working on the task.
answer_4.guideline: classify each pair into one of the following categories: aligned, partially-aligned, or not-aligned
